analysis.reason:
RSI 46.9에서 60.7로 상승하며 과매도 구간 탈출 확인.
MACD 히스토그램 0.9346에서 5.6149로 개선되며 강세 확산.
5일 저가 $556.10 > 20일 저가 $537.27로 Higher Low 패턴 회복 초입 진입.
analysis.reasonEn:
RSI rose from 46.9 to 60.7, confirming exit from oversold territory.
MACD histogram improved from 0.9346 to 5.6149, indicating bullish expansion.
The 5-day low of $556.10 is higher than the 20-day low of $537.27, signaling the initial stage of a Higher Low pattern recovery.
